title: xlsx_generic
description: Contract of the generic tabular XLSX template (`xlsx-generic`), rendered by functions/delivery/renderers/xlsx-generic/render.py (openpyxl) and recalculated by office-tools /api/recalc before release. Colour convention: blue = input value, black = formula, teal header = column title; risk bands High >= 7.0 / Medium >= 4.0 / Low < 4.0 (governance/RISK_THRESHOLDS.md).

name.description: Excel sheet name limit; the renderer truncates at 31 characters.

rows.description: Row values in column order. A string starting with '=' is written as a formula and recalculated by office-tools.

number_formats.description: Column name -> Excel number format, e.g. {"Residual": "0.0"}.

conditional.description: Column name -> rule; only 'risk_band' exists (red >= 7.0, amber >= 4.0, green < 4.0).
